features.name: Quick Add
steps: Create a task named "Review quarterly report" and schedule it for tomorrow at 3:00 PM using natural-language date input.
features.expected: Natural-language date input must parse correctly ("tomorrow at 3:00 PM"); the task is created with the correct schedule.

features.name: Quick Add
steps: Create a task named "Prepare weekly summary" for next Friday, assign priority 2, and place it directly in a specified project.
features.expected: Date, priority, and project must all apply correctly to the created task.

features.name: Quick Add
steps: Create a task named "Team standup" that repeats every weekday at 9:00 AM and verify that the recurring schedule is attached to the task.
features.expected: Recurring schedule (every weekday at 9:00 AM) must attach to the task and display correctly.

features.name: Quick Add
steps: Create a task for the first Monday of next month, assign a label, set its priority, and confirm that all parsed task properties are correct before leaving the task.
features.expected: Parsed properties (date, label, priority) must all be correct before leaving the task.

features.name: Inbox
steps: Capture three unrelated tasks in Inbox, then organize each one by assigning an appropriate date, priority, and destination project.
features.expected: Captured tasks must be organizable by date, priority, and project; each assignment applies correctly.

features.name: Inbox
steps: Create an unscheduled task in Inbox, later add a due date and priority, then confirm that it appears in the appropriate planning view without leaving an unnecessary duplicate in Inbox.
features.expected: Adding a due date and priority moves the task to the planning view without leaving a duplicate in Inbox.

features.name: Projects
steps: Create a new project named "Website Launch", add a project description, and create several tasks representing different stages of the launch.
features.expected: Project must be created with description; tasks must appear within it correctly.

features.name: Projects
steps: Create a project with five tasks, assign different dates and priorities to them, and organize the project so that the highest-priority work is clearly identifiable.
features.expected: Dates and priorities must save; the highest-priority work is clearly identifiable in the project.

features.name: Projects
steps: Move an existing task from Inbox into a specified project, preserve its existing schedule, and verify that its task metadata remains unchanged after the move.
features.expected: Moving a task to a project must preserve its schedule and metadata.

features.name: Projects
steps: Create two tasks in a project, convert one into a subtask of the other, and verify that the resulting parent-child hierarchy is correct.
features.expected: Converting a task into a subtask must create the correct parent-child hierarchy.

features.name: Projects
steps: Reorganize several existing tasks by moving them into a different project while preserving their dates, priorities, and labels.
features.expected: Moving tasks between projects must preserve dates, priorities, and labels.

features.name: Task Details
steps: Create a task, add a detailed description, create two subtasks, assign a priority, add a label, and schedule the parent task for a specific date.
features.expected: Description, subtasks, priority, label, and date must all save correctly on the task.

features.name: Task Details
steps: Open an existing task, change its priority from P4 to P1, reschedule it to tomorrow, and add a comment explaining why it was reprioritized.
features.expected: Priority change, reschedule, and comment must all apply correctly to the task.

features.name: Task Details
steps: Add multiple subtasks to an existing task, schedule the subtasks on different days, complete one subtask, and leave the parent task incomplete.
features.expected: Subtasks must be schedulable independently; completing one leaves the parent incomplete.

features.name: Task Details
steps: Duplicate an existing task, modify the copy's title and date, move the duplicate to another project, and ensure the original task remains unchanged.
features.expected: Duplicating must create an independent copy; modifying the copy leaves the original unchanged.

features.name: Task Details
steps: Add an attachment or link to an existing task together with a comment, then reopen the task and verify that the supporting information is still available.
features.expected: Attachment and comment must persist after reopening the task.

features.name: Task Details
steps: Configure a task with a due date and a separate deadline so that the work is scheduled before the final deadline, then verify both dates are represented correctly.
features.expected: Due date and deadline must both display correctly with work scheduled before the final deadline.

features.name: Task Details
steps: Create a recurring task, complete the current occurrence, and verify that Todoist schedules the next occurrence rather than permanently closing the task.
features.expected: Completing a recurring occurrence must schedule the next occurrence instead of closing the task.

features.name: Task Details
steps: Create a monthly recurring task for the last working day of each month and verify that the recurrence pattern reflects the requested schedule.
features.expected: Monthly recurrence for the last working day must reflect the requested pattern.

features.name: Task Details
steps: Modify the schedule of an existing recurring task without accidentally converting it into a one-time task, then verify the next recurrence.
features.expected: Modifying a recurring task must keep it recurring and the next occurrence must be correct.

features.name: Today
steps: Review the tasks shown in Today, complete one task, postpone another to tomorrow, and reprioritize a third task for immediate attention.
features.expected: Completing, postponing, and reprioritizing tasks in Today must all update correctly.

features.name: Today
steps: Take an overdue task visible in Today, reschedule it to a realistic future date, and confirm that it no longer appears as overdue.
features.expected: Rescheduling an overdue task removes its overdue status.

features.name: Today
steps: Prepare today's work plan by selecting several existing tasks from different projects, rescheduling them to today, and assigning priorities that reflect execution order.
features.expected: Selected tasks must move to today with priorities reflecting the intended execution order.

features.name: Upcoming
steps: Review the upcoming week, move one task to tomorrow, another to next week, and assign a specific time to a third task while keeping their projects unchanged.
features.expected: Moving tasks across dates must preserve their projects; assigned times display correctly.

features.name: Upcoming
steps: Rebalance an overloaded day by moving several scheduled tasks across different dates in the upcoming week and verify that no task is duplicated or lost.
features.expected: Rebalancing must not duplicate or lose any task.

features.name: Upcoming
steps: Schedule a set of related tasks across several consecutive days so that preparation, execution, and follow-up occur in the intended chronological order.
features.expected: Scheduled tasks must appear across the consecutive days in the intended chronological order.

features.name: Filters & Labels
steps: Create a label named "deep-work", apply it to tasks across multiple projects, and use the label view to confirm that all labeled tasks can be found together.
features.expected: Label must apply across projects; the label view must show all labeled tasks together.

features.name: Filters & Labels
steps: Create a filter that shows high-priority tasks due today, then verify that tasks outside the date or priority criteria are excluded.
features.expected: Filter must include only high-priority tasks due today; others are excluded.

features.name: Filters & Labels
steps: Create a filter that returns tasks from a specified project that have a selected label and are due within the next seven days.
features.expected: Filter must return only tasks matching project, label, and date-window criteria.

features.name: Filters & Labels
steps: Create a multi-condition filter for overdue or high-priority tasks across multiple projects, inspect the results, and correct any task whose properties cause it to appear unexpectedly.
features.expected: Multi-condition filter results must be correct; misclassified tasks are fixable by correcting properties.

features.name: Filters & Labels
steps: Create two labels for different work contexts, assign them to several tasks, and use filters to separate tasks that require focused work from tasks that can be completed quickly.
features.expected: Labels and filters must separate tasks by work context correctly.

features.name: Activity Log
steps: Make several changes to tasks across Inbox and a project, then use Activity Log to identify the most recent task creation and project-related change.
features.expected: Activity Log must correctly identify the most recent task creation and project-related change.

exclusions.feature:
Team collaboration and assignments
Assigning tasks to other users, shared projects

Pro plan features
Reminder history, extra filters, backups per plan

Real-time sync across devices
Cross-device state sync, presence
exclusions.reason: Real-time sync infrastructure; local persistence testable

exclusions.feature:
Natural-language date parsing full grammar
Complete NL date grammar parity with Todoist

exclusions.feature:

Real notification delivery

exclusions.feature:

exclusions.feature:
Cloud backup export/import

Karma productivity algorithm
Exact karma scoring rules

Wear OS / mobile-specific behaviors
